paragraphs: file_ext: 355 of 355 rows have known values (100.0% coverage).

At k = 50, mean shared-label agreement is 53.2% when weighting positive anchor–label pairs, and 53.2% when weighting labels equally. Mean individual label lift is 1.063 and equal-label lift is 1.063. Mean lift is not aggregate purity divided by aggregate chance.

png: 178 known positives; 178 evaluable positive anchors have 53.7% mean agreement, versus 50.1% reference prevalence (lift 1.071). An average of 50 of 50 neighbors have known annotations. Large lift for a rare label can coexist with low agreement.

jpg: 177 known positives; 177 evaluable positive anchors have 52.6% mean agreement, versus 49.9% reference prevalence (lift 1.056). An average of 50 of 50 neighbors have known annotations. Large lift for a rare label can coexist with low agreement.
Known-neighbor coverage at this k is 100.0%. Unknown neighbors are excluded from agreement denominators; missing annotations can bias the result.

The saved null comparison gives an empirical one-sided p-value of 0.1667 for macro_lift. This tests the specified shuffle, not semantic understanding; use the combined multiple-testing table and practical effect sizes when judging the finding.
The probe panel measures recoverability on a held-out split. Compare each model with its baseline; recoverability and nearest-neighbor usefulness answer different questions.
baseline: balanced_accuracy 0.5, macro_f1 0.2857; 90 held-out test rows (or the macro summary of supported binary tags).
linear: balanced_accuracy 0.6667, macro_f1 0.6535; 90 held-out test rows (or the macro summary of supported binary tags).

For paired_micro_purity at k = 50, A is 0.5317 and B is 1, with B−A 0.4683 across 355 paired anchors. Conditional 95% interval: 0.4584 to 0.4762; higher is better for this measure. This does not rank overall embedding quality.

Embedding A normalization comparison on identical held-out rows: raw_standardized: balanced_accuracy 0.6667, unit: balanced_accuracy 0.6389, unit_standardized: balanced_accuracy 0.6759, norm_only: balanced_accuracy 0.4444. Direction-only and magnitude-only scores describe accessible information for these pipelines; fit telemetry does not establish encoder-training stability.

Embedding B normalization comparison on identical held-out rows: raw_standardized: balanced_accuracy 1, unit: balanced_accuracy 1, unit_standardized: balanced_accuracy 1, norm_only: balanced_accuracy 0.4398. Direction-only and magnitude-only scores describe accessible information for these pipelines; fit telemetry does not establish encoder-training stability.

In the unit_chordal filtration for embedding A, the shuffled-minus-observed component variation gap exceeds 0.02 at 1 of 10 evaluated radii, across 2 sampled cohorts. This is descriptive annotation organization across correlated scales, not a topology significance test or a semantic quality grade.

In the unit_chordal filtration for embedding B, the shuffled-minus-observed component variation gap exceeds 0.02 at 6 of 10 evaluated radii, across 2 sampled cohorts. This is descriptive annotation organization across correlated scales, not a topology significance test or a semantic quality grade.

In the raw_euclidean filtration for embedding A, the shuffled-minus-observed component variation gap exceeds 0.02 at 1 of 10 evaluated radii, across 2 sampled cohorts. In the raw_euclidean filtration for embedding B, the shuffled-minus-observed component variation gap exceeds 0.02 at 5 of 10 evaluated radii, across 2 sampled cohorts. Next: compare feature measurements across scales, check probe gains against baselines, or summarize a selected region. Shared labels and correlated features can suggest patterns, but do not establish why the model retrieved an item.
